seeds: all V9 first-frame detector boxes confidence >= 0.25; no GT initialization
sam: same SAM2.1 tiny, CPU, imgsz1024 as V9
matching: one-to-one Hungarian IoU; accept IoU >= 0.5 and row/column alternative margin >= 0.15
unmatched_id: 10000 + baseline tracker ID (explicit fallback; may fragment)
scores: SAM scores are presence flags, not calibrated identity probability
evaluation: GT read only after all predictions saved; unchanged full-scene IoU0.5 metrics
scope: development diagnostic; all objects seeded in first frame only, new entries use baseline
